artifact.name: NDH Runtime Roadmap
artifact.purpose: Define the NDH runtime architecture sequencing across semantic, verification, structural, DSL, FFI, and ANIMA ingestion layers.

phases.name: Semantic Foundation
phases.role: Define NDH semantics, governance, invariants, and visibility surfaces.

phases.name: Lean Formal Verification
phases.role: Prove reversibility, drift-neutrality, admissibility, compatibility, membrane safety, and altitude safety.

phases.name: Rust Structural Runtime
phases.role: Implement safe, deterministic runtime envelopes aligned with Lean proofs.

phases.name: Python Semantic DSL
phases.role: Wrap Rust envelopes and expose NDH semantic operators and reversible, drift-neutral transformations.

phases.name: Rust↔Python FFI
phases.role: Bind Rust to Python with membrane- and altitude-safe interfaces.

phases.name: ANIMA Runtime Ingestion
phases.role: Allow ANIMA to see and traverse the verified runtime structure in a non-activating, system-agnostic, sovereignty-preserving way.

provenance.non_activation_clause: Declarative-only. Does not activate NDH geometry, runtime physics, solver behavior, or constellation routing.
